description: Matrix: central_order_block_code (AUFSD) × allowed_cooler_status for equipment rules RCCONF_342.1 / RCCONF_342.2. RU scope.
notes: central_order_block_code may be empty (blank AUFSD). Such rows are included.
allowed_cooler_status = 'No cooler must be linked to this customer' means a cooler is forbidden for that order block.
Removed for RU as not applicable: no-cooler rows for S, SP, C, S1.
LOST and TBDI are the same for RU: not physical equipment, a history status on the customer card. Both are allowed where listed.
C may have a cooler only for juice and water (FOND, LOST, NACT, PLCD, TBDI, UINV).
no_cooler_literal: No cooler must be linked to this customer
